paragraphs: Nutri-Link Technologies sells school nutrition software to public and private K-12 schools, districts, and food service providers. The cloud-based school payment products cover meal ordering, fee collection, free and reduced processing, and dismissal management.

MyMealLine is a cloud-based school cafeteria POS system designed for K-12 school nutrition operations. It runs on devices a district already has, with no client software to install. Pricing is a site-based annual subscription.

Nutri-Cloud manages the National School Lunch Program eligibility process, covering online application collection, automated processing, status notifications, and integration with the cafeteria point-of-sale. The application is available in 33 languages. Online School Fees can also be used by a district for other fees, activities, and events.

quote.text: Nutri-Cloud is a form management system for Free & Reduced priced meal applications or income surveys which provide benefits to parents and guardians in your school or school district.
